Keep foreign-client constants out of the env rename

renameEnvPrefix matched any CLAUDE_CODE_<X> token, so it would also
rename TypeScript constants that model the foreign client rather than
configure thyrox: the claude-code-20250219 beta header sent on the
wire, its settings schema URL, its docs map and its guide agent.
OmniRoute draws the same line with CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_VERSION.

Those five names now live in FOREIGN_CONSTANTS and the renamer leaves
them intact. The suite checks that every CLAUDE_CODE_* declaration in
src/ belongs to the set, so a new one cannot be renamed silently.
Annulment: dropping the skip fails one case; emptying the set fails
both new cases.
